children: Adel Alghanim Automotive, the exclusive distributor of MG Motor in Kuwait, has unveiled its new 25,500 sq m MG 4S Facility in Shuwaikh, investing $30 million.
The development underscores MG’s ongoing growth in the region and its commitment to providing customers with a comprehensive sales and ownership experience.

The new showroom reflects Adel Alghanim Automotive’s long-term confidence in the Kuwaiti market and commitment to MG Motor’s continued growth. Designed around the customer journey, the facility brings MG’s complete vehicle range and its full aftersales operation together under one roof.

Spread over five floors, it brings every stage of ownership into a single site. Up to 25 vehicles are displayed across the ground floor, with offices on the second and customer parking on the roof. The facility also houses a service centre, a dedicated aftersales area with its own customer parking, an on-site parts warehouse, a designated vehicle delivery area, and a customer lounge and café. It is the scale of the site that makes this possible: from purchase to servicing to genuine parts, customers are not sent anywhere else.

Marzooq Adel Alghanim, President, Alghanim Sons Group, commented: "This facility is a statement of confidence for Kuwait, our customers, and the future of the MG brand. As one of the largest MG 4S facilities in the Middle East and the world, it reflects our ambition to create an automotive destination that embodies the quality, innovation, and global success of MG Motor while delivering an exceptional experience for every customer who walks through our doors."

The opening comes amid strong global momentum for MG. Backed by SAIC Motor, one of the world's largest automotive manufacturers, MG has evolved from its iconic British roots into a globally recognised brand with a presence in more than 100 countries and regions.
Across the Middle East, the brand has become one of the region's fastest-growing automotive names, achieving annual sales of more than 70,000 vehicles while continuing to expand its market presence.

In Kuwait, MG has established itself as one of the country's leading automotive brands through a product lineup that combines advanced technology, contemporary design, performance, safety, and exceptional value. Models including the all-new MG Rakan, MG RX9, MG HS, MG ONE, MG7, and the award-winning MG Cyberster continue to attract strong customer demand and reinforce the brand's growing popularity across the market.

Jacky Xu, Managing Director, MG Motor in the Middle East, added: “Kuwait has been an important market for MG for many years, and this investment reflects both the strength of our partnership with Adel Alghanim Automotive and the confidence we share in the opportunities ahead. As MG continues to grow across the Middle East, strong local partners and continued investment in the customer experience will be fundamental to that progress. This new facility brings those elements together, providing a strong platform for the next chapter of MG’s development in Kuwait.”—TradeArabia News Service
